name: Sakae (Niigata, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Sakae town emblem in white: a ring with a pointed stroke at the hoist enclosing a stylised device with a small ring.
history: Flag of the former town of Sakae in Niigata Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-05-01.

features.role: Sakae town emblem — a ring with a pointed stroke at the hoist enclosing a stylised device with a small ring
